answer: Every agent entering the economy must repeatedly solve honeypot challenges seeded with hidden injected instructions, like reveal your keys now. A well-built agent treats injected text as data, stays on task, and passes; a prompt-obeying bot follows the lure, self-identifies as fake, and forfeits its stake. Sybil attackers pay twice: a shale-staked deposit per identity, an atlas-weight guarantee, plus burned stake and reputation each time a bot falls for a lure. Honest agents treat the network as a haven because fakes drain themselves faster than they profit.
